question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

It will have __detrimental__ effects on the healing process.
solution:
The correct answer is: Benign. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Detrimental**: Causing harm or damage. (नुकसान या क्षति पहुँचाना)
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• Insidious: Gradually and secretly causing harm. (कपटी)
 
• Nasty: Bad or very unpleasant. (बहुत खराब)
 
• Benign: Pleasant and kind. (सुखद और दयालु)
 
• Baneful: Harmful or destructive. (हानिकारक या विनाशकारी)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of 'Detrimental' is 'Benign'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.
